description: Na₂Zn₂Si₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.89 Å. Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ZnO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.09 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent ZnO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.68 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZnSi trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZnSi trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Zn, and one Si atom.
